purpose: The reviewed dependency advisories the CI gate accepts. scripts/audit-baseline-compare.mjs runs `npm audit --omit=dev --json`, keys every finding, and fails the build on any key absent from the findings list below. Nothing regenerates this file: a new advisory is accepted only by a human adding its entry, with a reason, in a reviewed commit that also moves reviewedOn.
reviewBasis: Reachability was determined package by package rather than assumed: a boot-time module-load probe established which vulnerable packages load at all (@google-cloud/firestore, jws, node-forge, uuid) and which never do (protobufjs, websocket-driver, faye-websocket, fast-xml-parser, form-data, @grpc/grpc-js, jsonwebtoken), and each loaded package's vulnerable path was then traced to the input it actually receives. Each entry below carries the result for its own package.
acceptedUntil: The next firebase-admin major upgrade. Every entry here is reachable only through firebase-admin, and the whole cluster clears with firebase-admin@14.4.0 — a semver-major that removes the namespaced API this application uses at five call sites, so it is a separately scoped change recorded in docs/meal-planning/release-and-recovery.md rather than part of this work.
refreshProcedure: Run `npm run audit:gate`. On a failure it prints each new finding as the entry that would accept it; paste the entry in with a real reason, move reviewedOn to today, and state in the commit message why the finding is accepted or how it was fixed. Entries it reports as no longer present may be deleted in the same pass — a finding that is gone can never be a regression, so pruning never fails the gate.

findings.title: form-data uses unsafe random function in form-data for choosing boundary
findings.reason: Never loaded at boot (module-load probe): no code path in src/ or the CLI scripts builds a multipart body. Reachable only through firebase-admin's storage/gax stack, which this service does not call. Clears only with firebase-admin@14.4.0 (semver-major, out of scope).

findings.title: node-forge has ASN.1 Unbounded Recursion
findings.reason: Loaded lazily at firebase-admin credential-internal.js:177 to parse OUR OWN service-account PEM, never attacker-supplied input, so none of the ASN.1/signature-forgery paths takes untrusted data. Clears only with firebase-admin@14.4.0 (semver-major, out of scope).

findings.reason: Token verification runs through the nested jws 3.2.2 with RS256 pinned (firebase-admin lib/utils/jwt.js:173); the hoisted 4.0.0 copy is used only for outbound signing with our own key, so the HMAC-confusion path takes no attacker input. Clears only with firebase-admin@14.4.0 (semver-major, out of scope).

findings.title: qs's arrayLimit bypass in comma parsing allows denial of service
findings.reason: Query parsing is bounded before it reaches a handler: every route reads fixed, individually parsed fields and the server answers 431 on an oversized URL and 413 over the body limits, so the array/bracket-expansion DoS paths have no amplification here. Fixed in express 4.22.3+; tracked with the express bump.
